_comment: Required env vars per Railway service — the gate scripts/check_env_manifest.py
enforces before every ship (scripts/ship.sh). The class this kills: a var that
exists on one service but not its sibling is a SILENT no-op for weeks
(REPLYIO_API_KEY absent on discovery-cron = 13 days of frozen Reply.io heat;
'_comment:' are provenance notes (which entrypoint/module reads the group) and
are ignored by the checker, as is every top-level key starting with '_'.
Presence-only: the gate checks a var is set and non-empty, never its value.
_optional lists vars that are recognized (knobs with code defaults, kill
switches, routing maps, dark/single-home features) so they are never flagged
as required OR as zombies; anything live that is neither required anywhere
nor listed here shows up in the checker's 'extra' column (the
TRIGIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET class: integration deleted, var lives on).
BUILD_STAMP is ignored entirely (ship.sh manages it), as are RAILWAY_*.
